mapper.sql: E.EVENT_NO, E.EVENT_TITLE, E.USE_YN, E.DISPLAY_YN, E.EVENT_START_DATE, E.EVENT_END_DATE, E.REG_DATE, E.REG_ID, E.UPDT_DATE, E.UPDT_ID, (SELECT EI.IMAGE_URL FROM event_image EI WHERE EI.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND EI.MAIN_IMAGE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EI.EVENT_IMAGE_NO DESC LIMIT 1) MAIN_IMAGE_URL, CASE WHEN NOW() > E.EVENT_END_DATE THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'ONGOING' END PROGRESS_STATUS
mapper.select: SELECT FROM event_info E WHERE E.USE_YN = 'Y' AND E.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND E.EVENT_START_DATE <= NOW() ORDER BY E.EVENT_START_DATE DESC, E.EVENT_NO DESC
SELECT FROM event_info E WHERE E.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo}
SELECT GOODS_NO FROM event_goods WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} ORDER BY EVENT_GOODS_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_info (EVENT_TITLE, USE_YN, DISPLAY_YN, EVENT_START_DATE, EVENT_END_DATE, REG_DATE, REG_ID, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{eventTitle}, #{useYn}, #{displayYn}, #{eventStartDate}, #{eventEndDate}, NOW(), #{regId}, NOW(), #{updtId})
INSERT INTO event_goods (EVENT_NO, GOODS_NO, REG_DATE, REG_ID, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{eventNo}, #{goodsNo}, NOW(), #{regId}, NOW(), #{regId})
INSERT INTO event_image (EVENT_NO, MAIN_IMAGE_YN, IMAGE_URL, REG_DATE, REG_ID, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{eventNo}, 'Y', #{imageUrl}, NOW(), #{regId}, NOW(), #{regId})
